parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of float precision in FITS cards, but introduces a loop that may not be optimal.

issues.description: The loop that attempts different precisions until the string representation converts back to the same float may introduce unnecessary computational overhead.
The code could benefit from comments explaining the logic behind the loop and the normalization of the exponent format.
